headline: President Bush creates an emergency board to look into labor disputes between Amtrak and some of its union-represented workers.
what_it_does: This order sets up an emergency board to investigate disputes between Amtrak (the National Railroad Passenger Corporation) and certain of its employees who are represented by labor unions. The title does not say which unions are involved or what the disputes are about. Boards like this are usually set up under federal railroad labor law to study a dispute and make recommendations, often while a strike or other changes are put on hold.

who_it_affects.group: Amtrak employees represented by the unions involved
who_it_affects.how: Their labor dispute with Amtrak will be reviewed by the emergency board.
Its dispute with these unions will be investigated by the board.
Setting up a board like this can delay a possible strike or work stoppage while the dispute is reviewed.
